entities.name: Post-War Industrialisation & Russification
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Massive reconstruction rebuilt Minsk as a Soviet model city. Belarusian SSR became a major industrial centre (tractors, electronics, petrochemicals) while Russification suppressed Belarusian language and culture.
